name: Signal Amplifier - Re-ATK
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Re-ATK capability.

61170.name: TacW DMG Reduction II · Re-ATK
61170.SpecificEffects:
When attacked by a Tactical Weapon, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>.
After triggering [Re-ATK], Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
